links.source_location: Regulatory View is the UI surface for the Regulatory Compliance Module (Layer 3)
Key Technical Decisions: Regulatory rules engine — Custom rule engine (YAML/JSON config) — Each jurisdiction has unique rules; config-driven flexibility
Key Technical Decisions: Audit storage — Append-only with digital signatures — Tamper-evident, legally defensible
Key Technical Decisions: Timer implementation — Redis sorted sets + background workers — Precise, scalable countdown timers
Key Technical Decisions: Breach prediction — LightGBM on real-time features — Calibrated probabilities, fast inference
Agent Workspace features: AI-generated draft appears in editor; center panel: AI draft response editor
Both are complaint-handling dashboards in Layer 4; supervisor HQ is for team leaders, agent workspace for individual agents
Live Team Performance: Burnout risk indicators (from Cognitive Load Manager)
Key Technical Decisions: Routing algorithm — Constraint-based optimisation (OR-Tools) — Multi-factor optimisation with constraints
Key Technical Decisions: Skill scoring — Bayesian updating from outcomes — Converges to true skill level over time
Key Technical Decisions: Personalisation context — RAG: customer history + resolution KB + complaint context — Grounded, specific responses
Dependencies: Trend Analyst (trend data, patterns); AI-Generated Insights Feed uses trend patterns
Key Technical Decisions: Simulation engine — Discrete event simulation (SimPy / custom) — Model complex complaint flows with timing
Key Technical Decisions: Theme discovery — HDBSCAN on complaint DNA vectors — Dynamic cluster count, noise handling
